NEW FINDINGS IN TOUCHED AREAS:
A4-R4-F1 | BLOCKER | start_effect's duration input descriptions still impose false typed-only boundaries

Invariant and authority: selected capability input/exclusion declarations must truthfully describe their bounded support (ADR 0020 Decision 3; transition design 5.9 condition 6). This is the same software capability-description class as A4-F1, in the expressly requested start_effect duration sibling. It is not a new source-completeness or deterministic-coverage requirement.

Concrete evidence at the pinned SHA:
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolStartEffect.ts:181 says duration is required except for a magic-item effect with a typed duration, and only describes fixed/dice omission. A real paid gray Bag grant has no duration object; it declares revertOn next-dawn. Nevertheless start_effect without duration succeeds with an engine-computed 360-minute lifetime. The omission path is explicit at toolStartEffect.ts:645-668 and enforced at activeEffects.ts:4776-4805. The same tool's main description at :76-79 already describes this exception, so its schema description contradicts the body as well as the accepted call.
- toolStartEffect.ts:186 says durationOverride is declared ONLY when overriding a typed item duration. Both real Wings flight and armor static-resistance effects have no typed duration; start_effect with a 10-minute duration and {basis:'house-rule', reason:'R4 explicit adjudication of an untyped power'} succeeds and records dm-override. The untyped override path is at toolStartEffect.ts:672-695. The body at :74-75 additionally describes required override for an untyped timed creature grant. Thus the typed-only input description is stale, not a restriction implemented by the engine.

Independent reproduction: node_modules/.bin/tsx /tmp/a4-start-schema.ts exits 0, captures the exact exported input descriptions and both accepted untyped-power calls, then performs the real paid next-dawn grant omission path. Log /tmp/a4-r4-start-schema.log. No readiness waiver or pack modification; the Bag's actual spend/rolled-credit/actor binding is used. The existing refresh matrix itself starts a typed-absent power with override at itemGrantSummons.test.ts:2032-2040, so green behavior evidence cannot validate the false schema prose.

Reachability and ownership: start_effect is a live default-registry tool. ToolRegistry.definitions at toolRegistry.ts:218-223 forwards these exact schema descriptions to model adapters; the contradictory text is directly model-facing. Owner: active-effect tool/input declarations. These schema lines predate both PR #714 and PR #712 (git blame c5f32a3e5); this is an unrepaired sibling exposed by the requested expanded query, not a runtime regression introduced by either repair.

Consequence: callers receive incompatible instructions about when duration can be omitted and when an override is permitted. The first directly misstates a required input on an admitted paid-grant path; the second wrongly excludes an admitted override source case. No state corruption or SRD-rule violation is claimed. Correct prose elsewhere in the same tool does not reconcile categorical conflicting input guidance, just as it did not cure the original refresh contradiction.

Sibling analysis: the refreshed refresh_effect operation/exclusions/schema now distinguish these source cases correctly; start_effect's main description already knows next-dawn and untyped-grant exceptions. Other inspected elapsed-time/rest/item declaration paths did not expose another material duration contradiction. This is one stale source-case input-description finding with two manifestations, not separate per-item findings. Bag grants reference SRD pp.210-211; the power fixtures reference pp.208/251. The governing API truthfulness authority is ADR 0020, not an invented SRD API requirement.

Proportionate closure and evidence: update start_effect's duration and durationOverride input descriptions to agree with its source-case engine paths and main description, including computed next-dawn omission and admitted untyped overrides; retain runtime guards. Use reviewed declaration assertions plus existing typed-present/typed-absent/grant behavior evidence or a generalized source-case declaration/behavior check. No additional per-item permanent reproducer collection or runtime expansion is required.
